1.reason: The filter's own guard is asserted independently at the test's line 181; this case only checks that the live run id is carried through.

findings.text: _ready_set_coordinators and its `coordinators is None and ready_idle` branch are unreachable from the only production call site (reckon/serve.py:1878 passes no ready_idle) and no test executes the branch because every case passes coordinators= explicitly, so its swallow-all-exceptions fallback at line 1169 is never exercised.

the assertion compares the view's live_run against "run-live-s9", the run id the test itself supplied to the code under test, so it is a propagation check rather than an independent one and cannot catch a regression in where the value originates (the filter's own guard at line 181 is independent).

baseline_suite records exit_status 4 with completed true and failure_count 0 from a log whose own text is "no tests ran", so a promotion gate deriving added failures from it reads a baseline that never measured the base tree; the manifest discloses this at line 19 and the import-arm comparison is the substitute.
the header names revision f65f6cd9 (the base) while the log's own text says the mutation ran in the head worktree, so a reader comparing it against the reviewed head dfaf3328 sees the wrong revision.
